name: state
meaning: PiranhasState (1 bite, 2 attack wait, 3 swim, 4 leap)

name: attackOrder
meaning: g_piranhaAttackCount after this piranha's increment; only 1 sends the kill

name: attackTimerMs
meaning: 1000 ms between freezing Ralph and the bite

name: waterBox
meaning: water zone containing the spawn point; min.y = surface; the attack and target area

name: inflatableSheep
meaning: first InflatableSheep (class 0x84) in the level, or NULL; sent msg 0 arg 9 while inside waterBox

name: submerged
meaning: 1 = draw with the water tint (tintAmount 0x800 of g_waterColor); 0 while leaping out or attacking

name: path
meaning: the inline trajectory the follower runs on: count (2 for swim, 4 for leap), then the points (start, [surface skim in/out], target), pts[1..3] running on into pathMorePts

name: pathMorePts
meaning: path.pts[1..3]: where the inline trajectory's points continue past its one declared point; written as path.pts[i]

name: follower
meaning: 0x20-byte follower over path (speed 500, arrive radius 50, 3D); +0xa0 pointIndex drives the leap anim switches
